question: If A = 26 and T = 7, then AUTHENTIC = ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c193461e71dcd46b8837f5f79d7b09c44e036a8adcc80d5d88d8d02cd78c37f.png] 

Given:

A = 26

__
 
• A → Opposite → Z → Positional Value = 26 (which is the given code)

T = 7

 
• T → Opposite → G → Positional Value = 7 (which is the given code)
 
• The alphabets are coded as per their positional value in reverse alphabetical order.

The code for AUTHENTIC will be as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12d017915db544da904450324bf4dba95f944db62854bc38c728f0fdbaf598ba.png] 

Here, the code for AUTHENTIC will be 266719221371824.

Hence,** '****266719221371824'** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Shortcut to remember the reverse positional letters.
